judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token counts across tool rounds and handles undefined usage without producing NaN. However, it misses a specific acceptance criterion (which it even checked off in its own `.lore/dod.md`): updating the `afterModelResponse` signature in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` (e.g., renaming the parameter to `totalUsage`) and renaming the misleading `lastUsage` local variable. Additionally, the candidate creates a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file, puts `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts`, and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the tree, whereas the reference keeps `accumulateUsage` private in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and adds tests to the existing `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
